mapa.visibilidade: How I appear on the map
mapa.visibilidadeTexto: Right now you appear approximately (about 5 km). The full choice — invisible, city, approximate or precise — comes with the live brothers map.
mapa.agapeTextoAviso: Real Ágapes come with the fellowship features. This is a design sample.
mapa.dadosExemplo: Brothers, clubhouses and gas stations on this map are samples until real data arrives.

explicacao.asfalto: Avoids dirt, even if the trip gets longer. If there is no other way, it tells you how many km of dirt.
explicacao.misto: The shortest way, with or without dirt.
explicacao.terra: Looks for dirt roads whenever possible.

erros.semRede: No connection to the route server. Check your internet and try again.
erros.semRota: We could not find a motorcycle route to that place with this road type.
erros.semLocalizacao: No location yet. Allow location and go somewhere open.

rota.aviso: Dirt sections come from OpenStreetMap and may be incomplete in your area.
rota.semCaminhoSoAsfalto: There is no paved-only way here. This route avoids dirt as much as possible, but has {{km}} km of dirt.

pilotando.rotaRapida: Google did not accept the planned route; following its own route to the destination.
pilotando.sosTeste: Test version: SOS does not alert anyone yet. It will alert your group and contacts, but it does not replace 192 (ambulance) or 193 (fire brigade).
pilotando.dicaEntrada: Set the route while stopped. On the move, listen to the voice and only tap when safe.

navegacao.permissaoMotivo: We need your location to plan the route.
navegacao.aviso: Use while stopped or as a passenger. Don't touch the phone while riding.

erros.semPermissao: No location permission. Allow it in the phone settings.
erros.termosRecusados: Google's terms must be accepted to navigate.
erros.chaveNaoAutorizada: The Google key was not accepted. Tell the developer.
erros.semRede: No internet. Google navigation needs a connection.
erros.semRota: Could not plan a route to that destination.
erros.semLocalizacao: No GPS signal yet. Go somewhere open and try again.

vazios.feedTexto: Photos, trips and board notices arrive in the social stage.
vazios.passeiosTexto: Chapter schedules and the live convoy are coming soon.
vazios.conquistasTexto: Ride, visit clubhouses and join Ágapes to earn Bode Passport badges.

perfil.catalogoDesc: Every visual element in the app

catalogo.cartaoTexto: Leaves 7am from the clubhouse · 280 km · 18 going

movimento.texto: Feed, messages and settings are locked while the bike is moving. Stop to use them.

tema.explica: Automatic: Sun theme by day (better in strong sunlight) and Night after 6 pm.
